cues.text: Honest review time. Mochi rates her brand new bed. She is not shy.
The bed. One star. It's soft, which is suspicious. Ignored.
The box it came in? Five stars. She lives there now.
For everything else, there's PETTO. Meals, meds, vet visits, all in one calm app.
The box? She's got that covered.
PETTO. Free on iOS and Android.
